frames.sub_step: deck module 4 of 14, 'Well lids, FKM O-rings', coming down onto module 2, 'Specimens: Cu–Ni, NAB, DED', and module 3, 'PTFE blank on S4'
frames.label: Specimens, lids

frames.sub_step: 2  The capper lifts the seawater cap; the P20 builds the well from 135 µL of ASTM D1141 seawater (7 transfers)
frames.lit_action: P20 pipette: dispenses into well S1, above the meniscus
frames.label: Seawater fill

frames.sub_step: 5  The capper carries the electrode cap (leak-free Ag/AgCl, Pt coil) from its park cup and sets it over S1's boss
frames.lit_action: Capper: sets the cap over S1's boss
frames.label: Electrode cap

frames.sub_step: 6  Measured with the cap on: OCP 30 min, LPR ±10 mV, rest 5 min, +50 mV hold 10 min, OCP 5 min. The head is free meanwhile
frames.lit_action: Potentiostat: OCP, LPR, hold: the head is free
frames.label: OCP, LPR, hold

frames.sub_step: 7  The magnet lifts the cap off S1; it is dipped in DI water, then seawater, and parked
frames.lit_action: Capper: dips the cap in DI water
frames.label: Cap rinsed

frames.sub_step: 8  A new tip moves the 150 µL, then a 150 µL DI rinse, into tube 1 for ICP-MS
frames.label: ICP-MS sample

frames.sub_step: 10  The head camera images the spot. Next spot: S2
frames.label: Spot imaged
